verdict.rationale: Telemetry and usage-tracking opt-out is a fair privacy question for a SaaS AI video platform with an API and browser workspace, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions telemetry, analytics, or a usage-tracking opt-out. The sign-in complaint is about authentication options, not tracking, so it is not relevant.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
